summary: The page displays several visual defects in dark theme, notably broken letter spacing/accidental spaces in the relationship grid titles and severe text contrast issues in the header metrics and breadcrumbs.

issues.title: Erratic whitespace in title cells
issues.description: Text strings in the Title column contain unnatural spaces inside words.
issues.evidence: Words render as 'Re place', 'us-we st-2', 'tem p fire wall', and 'Ve rify' across multiple rows.
issues.suggestion: Fix font rendering or string formatting to remove spurious whitespace.

issues.title: Low contrast breadcrumb text and card label
issues.description: Breadcrumb description and the first metric card's label have insufficient contrast against their backgrounds.
issues.evidence: 'Latency spike on us-west-2 cluster' in the top bar is nearly black on black, and 'PRIORITY' label inside the first light card is illegible.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper dark theme color tokens for secondary text and card headers.
